name: Morimiya Saki
source:
She is a third-year student. She is a member of the Literature Club and the Library Committee.
She is a good student both publicly and privately, socially and outwardly.
However, deep down inside, she does not and cannot trust other people at all.

She was born a bastard and never knew her father's face.
She has a strong affection for her mother and still takes pity on her, as she is unable to forget the man who fathered him.
She loves reading and enjoys writing poetry herself.
